create_robot_arm_sensor: create a RobotArmSensor instance with a robot arm and optional torque sensors enabled
get_joint_positions: get the current joint positions from a MuJoCo physics body using the sensor
get_joint_velocities: get the current joint velocities from a MuJoCo physics body using the sensor
get_joint_torques: get the current joint torque sensor readings from a MuJoCo physics body
get_observables_dict: get the dictionary of observable objects mapping observation keys to Generic observables
